scope: 13 never-attempted cases from the fixed 18-group workload on current runtime; retain five historical observations separately with their original runtime identity. Not a single-runtime 18-case SLO claim.

warm_latency.population: All observed warm WSGI requests, including failures; startup and inter-request pacing excluded.

raw_format.population: Actual unmodified provider final texts; HTTP failures have no final text and are separately reported.

valid_provider_schema_per_attempt.population: Every actual provider attempt, including unavailable/timeout; no fallback counted as model output.

application_schema.policy: Includes error fallback; valid fallback is not successful Gemini format.

limitations: Exposed regression; at most 18 live samples, not the 300-case live baseline.
WSGI application-to-provider timing; excludes browser/TCP transit and 30s inter-request quota pacing.
Cold includes startup; one cold sample cannot establish a cold distribution.
Any HTTP/provider failures remain failures and do not count as valid Gemini format.
